articles.title: Marvel's X-Men Reboot: A New Professor X, a Sinister Villain, and a Storm on the Horizon
articles.summary: Marvel Studios unveiled its X-Men cast at D23: Adam Driver as Mr. Sinister, Christopher Abbott as Professor X, and newcomer Maya Boyd as Storm. The film hits theaters May 5, 2028.

articles.title: Disney Princesses Reunite for a One-Night-Only Concert — Here's How to Watch
articles.summary: The original voices of Ariel, Belle, Moana, Jasmine, and more performed together at Disneyland for a TV special airing Sunday at 8 p.m. ET on ABC and Disney+.

articles.title: Tako, the Octopus Who Played Piano, Retires After a Life of Music and Crabs
articles.summary: Tako, the octopus trained by YouTuber Mattias Krantz to play piano by pulling keys, has retired. Krantz ended the project to let Tako rest peacefully in his old age.
